changelog:
Initial release of keyapi-tiktok skill for TikTok analysis via KeyAPI.

- Provides natural-language access to TikTok creator, content, trend, commerce, and ad intelligence using KeyAPI REST API.
- Uses latest live KeyAPI docs to map business goals to API workflows and endpoint contracts.
- Enforces secure token-based authentication with onboarding guidance and credential checks.
- Supports workflows such as influencer discovery, product/shop research, trending analysis, live commerce, and multi-endpoint reports.
- Applies scenario-driven API routing, only asks for required information, and presents analytical user-facing answers.
summary: Analyze TikTok creators, TikTok Shop commerce, content, live streams, trends, ads, products, shops, categories, videos, hashtags, music, comments, and audience signals through the KeyAPI REST API using live official docs. Use for influencer discovery, product and seller research, video intelligence,
